component.name: Booru Grabber
component.summary: Search and download images from boorus and imageboards

description.p: Booru Grabber searches imageboards and boorus (Danbooru, Gelbooru, Moebooru, e621, Philomena, Pixiv, Zerochan and more), shows the results in tabs and downloads them with filenames built from the image tags, for example %artist%/%copyright%/%md5%.%ext%.
It is a GTK 3 rewrite of Grabber by Bionus that keeps its site sources and settings format.

ul.li: Searches several sites at once, with tag auto-completion, blacklist and post-filters
Batch downloads with resume, duplicate detection by MD5 and extension guessing
Favorites and monitors that notify about and download new images
Image viewer with animations and video playback

screenshot.caption: Search results with the tag sidebar
Image viewer with tags and details

description.p: First release of the GTK 3 rewrite of Grabber.
